tools.name: Undetected
tools.description: Undetectable AI is an AI-powered paraphrasing and detection tool that transforms machine-generated text into natural, human-like writing—making it undetectable by common AI content detectors.
bullets: High effectiveness rate in bypassing various AI detectors.
Produces genuinely human-like and natural-sounding content.

tools.name: MyDetector
tools.description: MyDetector.ai is a free and easy-to-use AI detector that utilizes advanced algorithms to analyze text and determine whether it was written by a human or an AI.
bullets: High Accuracy: Utilizes advanced algorithms for precise detection of AI-generated content.
User-Friendly: Simple interface and free access make it easy for anyone to use.

tools.name: Bypass GPT

bullets: High effectiveness can sometimes vary with highly technical or nuanced content.
Produces genuinely human-like and natural-sounding content.
